title: FX predictability complexity penalty

targets.rv: sum of daily squared log returns in month t
targets.left_tail: month-t return below trailing 60-month 20th percentile known at t-1

method.lookahead_control: All features, macro values, and thresholds are shifted at least one month; code uses shift(1) for predictors.
tests: Newey-West t-stat of benchmark loss minus model loss
Clark-West adjusted t-stat for return forecasts
Bootstrap Sharpe difference for sign strategy vs buy-hold, seed=42
method.publication_gate: Harvey-style |t| >= 3; positive model claims require t >= 3 after sign orientation.

limitations: ETF monthly proxy, not spot FX with real-time macro vintages.
Ridge-RFF hyperparameters are fixed ex ante; no nested tuning loop.
Local macro predictors are end-of-month FRED levels shifted one month; this is not a real-time vintage macro forecast design.
This is a free-data screen of the complexity-penalty hypothesis, not a replication of Kiliç (2025).
